name: CTIM-Bench
description:
CTIM-Bench: Benchmark for Traditional Chinese Music Generation
	

CTIM-Bench is a curated evaluation dataset consisting of 500 expert-validated high-fidelity samples, specifically designed to benchmark music generation models on traditional Chinese instruments. It serves as the test set for the CTIM-Gen project.
The dataset features 42.6% minority ethnic instruments (e.g., Matouqin, Hulusi), reflecting the rich diversity of Chinese musical culture.

	
		
	
	
		⚖️ Data Source & Usage… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CTIM-Gen/CTIM-Bench.
reputation: Niche, curated benchmark used primarily by the CTIM-Gen project and researchers focused on traditional Chinese instrument generation.
